question: roads intersecting 100m buffer around Teatro Nacional de São Carlos
sql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true), 100) AS g
  FROM lisbon_buildings
  WHERE names.primary = 'Teatro Nacional de São Carlos'
)
SELECT r.names.primary AS road_name
FROM lisbon_roads r, b
WHERE ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true), b.g)
ORDER BY 1;

question: convex hull of all religious buildings with area in hectares
sql:
WITH u AS (
  SELECT ST_ConvexHull(ST_Union_Agg(geometry)) AS hull
  FROM lisbon_buildings
  WHERE subtype = 'religious'
)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(hull) AS hull_geojson,
       ST_Area(ST_Transform(hull, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true)) / 10000 AS area_ha
FROM u;

question: residential buildings not within 15m of any road
sql:
WITH road_buf AS (
  SELECT ST_Union_Agg(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true), 15)) AS g
  FROM lisbon_roads
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM lisbon_buildings b, road_buf r
WHERE b.subtype = 'residential'
  AND NOT ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(b.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true), r.g);

question: distance from Teatro Nacional de São Carlos centroid to nearest road in metres
sql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT ST_Centroid(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true)) AS c
  FROM lisbon_buildings
  WHERE names.primary = 'Teatro Nacional de São Carlos'
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(b.c, ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true))) AS dist_m
FROM b, lisbon_roads r;

question: overlap area between 100m buffers of Edifício C and Rua dos Mareantes
sql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true), 100) AS g
  FROM lisbon_buildings
  WHERE names.primary = 'Edifício C'
),
r AS (
  SELECT ST_Union_Agg(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true), 100)) AS g
  FROM lisbon_roads
  WHERE names.primary = 'Rua dos Mareantes'
)
SELECT ST_Area(ST_Intersection(b.g, r.g)) AS overlap_m2
FROM b, r;

question: dissolved 10m buffer area of all footways in hectares
sql:
WITH buf AS (
  SELECT ST_Union_Agg(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true), 10)) AS g
  FROM lisbon_roads
  WHERE class = 'footway'
)
SELECT ST_Area(g) / 10000 AS area_ha
FROM buf;
